description: This line plot illustrates the Area Under the Curve (AUC) percentage as a function of the parameter N, ranging from 0 to 20 on the linear x-axis, with tick marks at intervals of 5. The y-axis represents AUC (%) on a linear scale, spanning from 75 to 100. Five distinct lines, each with a unique color and marker, depict different performance curves: a blue line with circle markers, an orange line with diamond markers, a green line with star markers, a red line with square markers, and a purple line with triangle markers. The blue line starts at approximately 94% at N=0, rises to 100% at N=5, remains at 100% until N=10, then declines to about 96% at N=20. The orange line begins at approximately 84% at N=0, increases to about 93% at N=5, and then rises to a peak of approximately 95% at N=10 before slightly declining to about 94% at N=20. The green line starts at approximately 87% at N=0, increases to about 91% at N=5, and then rises to about 93% at N=10 before slightly declining to about 92% at N=20. The red line begins at approximately 88% at N=0, increases to about 93% at N=5, peaks at 100% at N=10, and then declines to about 91% at N=20. The purple line remains relatively flat at approximately 80% from N=0 to N=5, then sharply increases to a peak of approximately 97% at N=10, and subsequently declines to about 82% at N=20.
